core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hanzala is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Lion's roar”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hanzala corresponds to the Arabic form حنظلة (Arabic root ح ن ظ ل (ḥ-n-ẓ-l); حَنْظَلَة (Ḥanẓala)). Its core sense is lion's roar; a bitter desert plant. Hanzala is Arabic حَنْظَلَة (Ḥanẓala), the name of a documented early Islamic figure (Ḥanẓala ibn Abī ʿĀmir, who was washed by the angels). The root ح ن ظ ل (ḥ-n-ẓ-l) is that of حَنْظَل, a bitter desert plant (colocynth), and the name is traditionally associated with the lion's roar.
